mirroredCall.title: Mirrored call
mirroredCall.summary: A call event from a telephony source, kept 30 days
mirroredCall.description: One row per call event that reached pipelinq: ringing, answered, ended or transferred. The row names who the caller is in pipelinq and what is open for them, resolved once when the event arrived. Rows are removed 30 days after they were written. No user reads this schema through the object API: a row holds a phone number.

callId.title: Call id
callId.description: The telephony source's identifier for the call. Every event of one call carries the same call id.

sourceId.title: Source
sourceId.description: The telephony source the event came through.

callerNumber.title: Caller number
callerNumber.description: The caller's number in E.164, or empty when the number was withheld.

callerName.title: Caller name
callerName.description: The name the telephony source resolved, or empty for an unknown caller.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: The agent the call is for, or empty.

at.title: At
at.description: When the telephony source says it happened, ISO 8601, or empty.

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: How long the call lasted. 0 except on an ended event.

openCases.title: Open cases
openCases.description: The case references the telephony source carried for the caller, as given.

inPipelinq.title: In pipelinq
inPipelinq.description: The clients and contacts that have the caller's number, each with their open tickets.

mirroredAt.title: Mirrored at
mirroredAt.description: When pipelinq wrote this row. The 30 days count from here.
